salsa20_core.description: crypto_core_salsa20(out, in, k, sigma) where sigma='expand 32-byte k'

poly1305.description: crypto_onetimeauth(out, msg, msglen, key) - key is passed raw; clamping is done internally by crypto_onetimeauth

curve25519.description: crypto_scalarmult(result, scalar, basepoint) where basepoint is the standard Curve25519 base point (9)

challenge.description: crypto_secretbox (XSalsa20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption). Decrypt to recover the plaintext.
challenge.notes: First 16 bytes of ciphertext are zero (BOXZEROBYTES=16). Bytes 16-31 are the Poly1305 MAC. Bytes 32+ are the XSalsa20-encrypted message. The plaintext message starts at offset 32 of the decrypted buffer (first 32 bytes are ZEROBYTES padding).
